baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction 'do not rise over Allah' joins ta'lu to an explicit over-relation.
baseline_models.mechanism: Elevation becomes a relational bid for domination: the addressees are forbidden to convert rank or strength into mastery over the very relation in which Allah is the worshipped one.

activation_trace.role: Haughty domination makes the rising a blameworthy superiority claim rather than neutral height.
Overcoming and gaining mastery supplies the action attempted through the preposition 'over.'
Worship and the worshipped one fixes the relation whose order the attempted mastery violates.

changed_reading.before: Do not behave proudly before God.
changed_reading.after: Do not turn elevation into a rival claim of mastery over the worship relation itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The speaker comes to the addressees with Sultan qualified by mubin.
baseline_models.mechanism: The arrival is part of the evidentiary event: the Sultan prevails as proof, while mubin locates its force in disclosed meaning rather than concealed pressure.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arriving makes the speaker's presence part of the confrontation with evidence.
Overpowering proof supplies a warrant that prevails through demonstration.
Disclosure by expression or sign makes exposed meaning the proof's operative force.

changed_reading.after: My arrival confronts you with a proof whose overpowering force is the meaning it discloses.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same Sultan can name authority or rule, and its qualification makes that authority manifest.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside the argumentative reading, the speaker may arrive under a conferred commission. Its legitimacy is publicly displayed rather than generated by his own elevation.

activation_trace.role: Granting and bringing permits the arrival to carry something conferred rather than self-produced.
Authority and rule makes Sultan a delegated commission alongside its proof sense.
Appearance and becoming clear makes the commission publicly inspectable.

changed_reading.after: The speaker also arrives under a delegated, publicly manifest commission.

context_deltas.mechanism: The clear Book is a written fixation; it is delivered downward, articulates an obligating command, and issues through sending. This makes the focus commission the local endpoint of a received dispatch, not the speaker's personal prestige.

activation_trace.role: Delegated authority supplies the commission whose upstream chain the context activates.
Becoming clear makes the received commission manifest at the encounter.
A written fixation that obligates judgment makes the Book the durable source of the commission.
Disclosure by expression makes the Book's clarity a communicable source rather than a hidden decree.
Sending down and delivering supplies the direction by which the warrant is received.
Request and obligation gives the descended matter directive force.
Messenger and message supplies the commissioned carrier who completes the dispatch chain.

structural_cues: 44:2-5 sequences clear Book, descent, apportioned command, and sending before the focus encounter.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies written obligation, downward delivery, command, and mission; I infer that chain stands behind the focus Sultan. A live alternative is that it creates only a parallel revelatory frame while Sultan remains independent proof.

changed_reading.before: A publicly manifest delegated commission accompanies the speaker.
changed_reading.after: The commission is the encounter-point of a written, descending, obligating dispatch; its authority is received rather than self-elevated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sky's coming with manifest smoke echoes the focus speaker's coming with manifest Sultan. Covering smoke followed by uncovering turns clarity from mere ease of comprehension into an arrival that makes a concealed condition impossible to ignore.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arriving supplies the shared event frame linking speaker and sky.
Overpowering proof makes the first arrival a confrontation by warrant.
Appearance and becoming clear supplies the manifest quality shared by both arrivals.
A second coming supplies the close structural echo to the focus arrival.
Being overtaken by ruin gives the smoke-arrival its destructive horizon and contrasts with the proof-arrival.
Smoke rising from fuel supplies the covering material borne by the parallel arrival.
Manifest appearance shows that mubin can mark unmistakability even when its object obscures.
Removing a cover makes revelation and relief the explicit counter-motion to smoke's covering.

structural_cues: 44:10 repeats the focus frame of an agent coming with a noun marked mubin; 44:11-12 then stage covering and uncovering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated coming-with-mubin frame and the cover/uncover sequence; I infer that the warrant-arrival is a non-destructive advance manifestation of what the smoke-arrival enforces. The live alternative is a formal echo with no causal ordering between them.

changed_reading.before: The speaker comes with an intelligible proof.
changed_reading.after: The speaker's manifest warrant is the non-destructive counterpart to a manifest overwhelming arrival: clarity exposes before force overtakes.

context_deltas.mechanism: A trusted envoy demands performance of a due concerning people whose abd inventory holds both owned servitude and worshipful obedience. The focus prohibition and commission arbitrate between those claims: human mastery cannot overtop divine belonging.

activation_trace.role: Overcoming and gaining mastery supplies the human claim that is being denied.
The worshipped-one relation supplies the prior belonging that human mastery cannot supersede.
Delegated authority makes the Sultan the warrant for changing the contested relation.
Messenger and message identifies the challenger as commissioned rather than self-appointed.
Praiseworthy honor and generosity gives the envoy standing without turning that standing into domination.
Performance of a right or trust frames the demanded conveyance as something due, not a seizure.
Slavery and ownership supplies the human possession-claim under dispute.
Worship and submissive obedience supplies the competing divine relation named in the same people.
Security and trust makes the envoy's reliability part of the transfer mechanism.

structural_cues: 44:17-19 places noble envoy, demand concerning God's servants, trusted mission, anti-elevation, and Sultan in one speech sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a due-performance verb, the ownership and worship branches of abd, a trusted envoy, and the anti-mastery clause; I infer a collision of jurisdictions over persons. A live alternative is a simple handover demand without a developed ownership claim.

changed_reading.before: Do not claim mastery over God; I carry delegated authority.
changed_reading.after: Relinquish the regime's possession-claim: people held under human mastery already stand in worshipful belonging to God, and the Sultan warrants their conveyance out of that rival jurisdiction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after claiming Sultan, the speaker seeks refuge from harm and, if refused belief, asks for separation. Bodily vulnerability and noncompulsion weaken the worldly-coercion branch while preserving proof and delegated warrant.

activation_trace.role: Coercive force let loose supplies the Sultan reading that the following sequence puts under pressure.
Overpowering proof supplies the authority mode that survives the speaker's physical vulnerability.
Seeking refuge and protection shows the Sultan-bearer relying on protection rather than deploying physical force.
Removal to one side supplies separation as the offered response to unbelief instead of compelled assent.

structural_cues: 44:20-21 immediately follows the Sultan claim with refuge from stoning and a request for withdrawal if belief is withheld.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies refuge, threatened harm, and separation after the authority claim; I infer that immediate human coercive capacity is not the Sultan's primary force. The live alternative is that delegated authority can coexist with, but need not exclude, worldly coercion elsewhere.

changed_reading.before: Sultan may be the speaker's power to coerce the addressees.
changed_reading.after: Its operative force here is proof or commission compatible with bodily exposure: the bearer seeks refuge and permits separation rather than forcing assent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later retrospective names rescue from humiliating punishment and characterizes Pharaoh with the same elevation root plus boundary-crossing excess. The focus prohibition becomes a diagnosis of a regime: theological self-height operationalizes as humiliating dominion.

activation_trace.role: Haughty domination supplies the focus action later embodied by Pharaoh.
Overcoming and mastery converts inner elevation into a governing mechanism.
Deliverance by separation supplies the reversal of the regime's enclosing mastery.
The non-dominant mapped branch of humiliation through contempt identifies the social output of the regime.
The repeated haughty-domination branch makes Pharaoh the context's concrete carrier of ta'lu.
Crossing the limit supplies the boundary logic by which elevation becomes excess.

structural_cues: 44:30-31 moves from rescue out of humiliating punishment to Pharaoh as elevated and among those exceeding limits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies humiliation, rescue, repeated alw, and limit-crossing in one characterization; I infer that rising over Allah is enacted politically by degrading others. A live alternative keeps the focus at personal arrogance and treats the political pattern as one example only.

changed_reading.before: Do not be arrogant toward God.
changed_reading.after: Do not reproduce a Pharaonic vertical order in which self-placement above divine limits licenses humiliating mastery over people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The giving of visible signs contains a manifest trial. Evidence therefore does not simply close uncertainty; by appearing, it places recipients in a test that makes their condition appear. The focus Sultan can both demonstrate and diagnose.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering proof supplies the evidentiary object whose effect the trial model revises.
Appearance and becoming clear lets evidence reveal both its case and its recipients.
Granting and bringing supplies signs as conferred evidence rather than discovered information.
A visible sign supplies the concrete evidentiary material placed before recipients.
Testing that makes a condition appear turns reception of a sign into diagnosis.
The non-dominant mapped inventory independently preserves trial as an event that reveals condition.
Manifest appearance qualifies the trial and joins testing to disclosure.

structural_cues: 44:33 puts giving, visible signs, an internal trial, and mubin in a single clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conferred signs, trial-as-revelation, and manifestness; I infer that the focus proof tests and exposes the recipient as well as proving a claim. The live alternative confines that testing function to the earlier recipients in 44:33.

changed_reading.before: The clear Sultan settles an external dispute.
changed_reading.after: The clear Sultan also stages a trial: its manifestation reveals what the addressees do when confronted by warrant.

context_deltas.mechanism: A person is dragged to the blaze, punishment is poured from above the head, and titles of might and honor are voiced in that abasement. The sequence materializes a reversal: attempted superiority ends beneath an imposed upper force.

activation_trace.role: Haughty domination supplies the claimed elevation that the later scene reverses.
The upper side and from-above image gives the prohibition a latent spatial axis.
Violent dragging under coercion supplies the downward loss of self-directed rank.
Physical upper direction makes punishment descend from the position the self-exalting claim sought.
Leadership and precedence lets the struck head carry the person's former status as well as anatomy.
Might after abasement supplies the status-title exposed by the scene's reversal.
Praiseworthy honor supplies the second elevated title made unstable by its punitive setting.

structural_cues: 44:47-49 sequences coerced dragging, pouring from above onto the head, and the paired status titles mighty and noble.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the vertical actions and status vocabulary; I infer that the scene answers the focus bid for elevation by spatial and social inversion. A live alternative reads the punishment independently and hears the titles without linking them back to ta'lu.

changed_reading.before: The prohibition warns generally against arrogant superiority.
changed_reading.after: The prohibition anticipates a reversal: whoever seeks the upper position through domination becomes the object beneath an imposed from-above force, while claimed titles collapse into exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement makes the message easy through the addressee-facing tongue so that it can be remembered. This activates Sultan's sharp-tongue branch but redirects verbal force away from abusive loudness toward accessible, effective disclosure.

activation_trace.role: A forceful sharp tongue supplies verbal efficacy as a latent mode of Sultan.
Disclosure by expression makes linguistic intelligibility the control on that verbal force.
Opening and ease after difficulty makes accessibility, not aggression, the route of efficacy.
Tongue as language and speech gives the warrant an audible and intelligible body.
Conveying a message by tongue makes speech the transport mechanism of commission.
Bringing something back to mind supplies durable recollection as the speech's intended effect.

structural_cues: 44:58 binds making-easy, the messenger-facing tongue, and recollection in one closing purpose construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ease, language, message-conveyance, and recollection; I infer that these specify how the focus Sultan exerts force. A live alternative treats 44:58 as general facilitation of the discourse with no special activation of the sharp-tongue Sultan branch.

changed_reading.before: The clear Sultan is an object carried by the speaker.
changed_reading.after: Its operative body may be the eased tongue itself: authority happens as intelligible utterance forceful enough to remain in memory.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the watercourse branch of ati against the ordinary coming verb and joins it to the later sea passage. It remains anchored in the focus arrival and commission, with explicit night travel, an open gap, and drowning in context. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for passage-making authority, never as a lexical translation of atikum.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The speaker's atikum is joined to Sultan, allowing arrival and authorization to be tested as a route-opening mechanism.

activation_trace.role: A watercourse and cleared flow supplies the route-making image for the authorized arrival.
Delegated authority supplies the warrant that opens passage rather than merely describing it.
Night travel supplies the movement that needs a protected channel.
Worshipful servants identify the party carried through the authorized route.
A wide split supplies the material channel through the sea.
A broad open gap makes the route remain traversable.
Drowning in water makes the same channel sort those conveyed through it from pursuers.

changed_reading.after: The authorized arrival opens a channel of transfer: it carries worshipful servants through while the same opening exposes the pursuing force.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the lighting-oil sense of Sultan is not the ordinary focus sense. It remains anchored in Sultan mubin and gains an optical mechanism from manifest smoke and removal of covering. Downstream prose should mark it strictly as an illumination analogy, not propose that Sultan literally means oil here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Sultan is directly qualified by mubin, permitting its lighting-oil branch to interact with appearance and concealment.

activation_trace.role: Oil used for lighting supplies an illuminant as the material analogy for warrant.
Appearance and becoming clear gives the imagined oil its revealing function.
Smoke rising from fuel supplies the paradoxical byproduct that can obscure while becoming manifest.
Manifest appearance lets even an obscuring medium become unmistakably exposed.
Lifting a cover supplies the successful revealing action of the illuminant analogy.

changed_reading.before: The clear authority states or proves a claim.
changed_reading.after: The warrant can be imagined as lamp oil: a medium that exposes the room, while the smoke sequence warns that manifestation may first reveal an engulfing cover.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers ati's outsider noun-image onto the focus verb. It remains anchored in the speaker's coming and in the repeated arrival of a noble messenger to another people. Downstream prose should qualify it as a social-position analogy: the commission is external to the host hierarchy, not proof that the verb lexically means outsider.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The first-person arrival with delegated Sultan can be read through ati's outsider-among-another-people branch.

activation_trace.role: An outsider among people not his own supplies the envoy's social position inside the addressed regime.
Delegated authority makes the outsider's standing derive beyond the host hierarchy.
Coming and becoming present supplies the envoy's entry into the other people's political field.
Messenger and message identifies the entrant as a carrier of external commission.
Praiseworthy honor gives the outsider standing that does not depend on local rank.

changed_reading.before: The speaker arrives with a credential.
changed_reading.after: The arrival inserts an externally authorized envoy into a closed hierarchy; local rank can neither generate nor cancel his commission.

strongest_changes: Sultan shifts away from immediate coercive capacity toward proof and received commission, because its bearer remains physically vulnerable and accepts separation rather than forcing assent.
The demand concerning God's servants turns the focus into an emancipation warrant: human ownership and mastery collide with prior worshipful belonging.
Pharaoh's repeated alw plus humiliating excess makes the anti-elevation clause political and social, not merely an inward warning against pride.
Manifest evidence also functions as trial and exposure; mubin can characterize an unsettling arrival, not only easy or comforting explanation.
The ending keeps an exploratory tongue-borne reading alive in which accessible speech is the effective body of the clear Sultan.
summary.what_was_special: The focus holds a deliberate tension between vertical domination and legitimate authority. Context does not collapse that tension: it distinguishes self-generated mastery from received warrant, then replays clarity through Book, smoke, envoy, trial, punishment, and eased speech. Direct root recurrence supports the strong models, while material and social branch crossings preserve live alternatives that a consensus gloss would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: Proof and delegated authority remain coexisting Sultan readings; the packet does not force a single lexical choice.
The causal arrow from manifest warrant to manifest punitive arrival is abductive; the repeated frame may be formal rather than sequential.
The trial model may characterize the signs in 44:33 without transferring fully to the focus Sultan.
The watercourse, lighting-oil, and outsider models are branch-backed analogies and should not be rendered as direct lexical glosses.
